chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ziyad ibn Abi al-Hallal, who said:
I had dinner with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) consisting of meat with milk, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'This is the gravy of the Prophets (peace be upon him)'.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about eating meat with milk?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Ziyad ibn Abi al-Hallal reports dining with Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) on a meal of meat and milk, which the Imam identified as 'maraq al-anbiya' (the broth/soup of the Prophets). This designation elevates the combination beyond mere permissibility, linking it to the dietary practices of the Prophets and suggesting a spiritual and physical vitality associated with the Ahl al-Bayt's culinary tradition.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ziyad Bin Abu Al Hallal who said,
‘I had dinner with Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> by meat with milk, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is the gravy of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ziyad ibn abu al-Halfal who has said the following: “
I once had dinner with abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and it was meat with milk. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is the sauce of the Prophets, ‘Alayhim al-Salam.’”
